about.html:1440.text: Our Company Journey

Akshar Engineering Services Pvt. Ltd. (Formerly known as Akshar Consultancy Services) was established as a dedicated technical assurance and third-party inspection powerhouse. We operate with complete impartiality, independence, and technical rigor across heavy engineering, oil & gas, chemical processing, power generation, renewables, and civil infrastructure.

From our founding, our guiding philosophy has remained unwavering: protect client capital investments and human lives through rigid technical compliance, verified material traceability, and zero-compromise adherence to international codes (ASME, API, AWS, ISO, EN, IBR).
Our Vision

To be the most trusted and recognized global technical inspection and project engineering partner, safeguarding critical industrial assets through uncompromising technical integrity and state-of-the-art engineering practices.
Our Mission

To provide thorough, timely, and fully independent quality assurance, vendor evaluation, and NDT engineering services, ensuring complete compliance with approved ITPs, statutory safety rules, and contractual specifications.
Impartiality Charter

As an ISO/IEC 17020 Type-A body, we guarantee total freedom from commercial, financial, or manufacturing pressures. Our inspectors evaluate purely on technical facts, code criteria, and physical measurement proofs.
Five Pillars of AES Excellence
The core operational disciplines that set Akshar Engineering Services apart in the global technical inspection landscape.
CSWIP & ASNT Certified Inspectors
Our personnel maintain active global qualifications including CSWIP 3.1, AWS CWI, ASNT Level III/II (UT/RT/MPI/DPT), NACE/AMPP Level 2, and API 510/570/653 certifications.
Rapid 24-48h Field Deployment
Strategic surveyor deployment hubs across major industrial corridors in Gujarat, Maharashtra, South India, and overseas networks for rapid on-site mobilization.
Immediate 24-Hour Flash Reports
Daily photographic flash summaries dispatched within 24 hours of inspection completion, giving engineering managers real-time visibility of vendor shop floors.
Complete Material Traceability
Rigid heat number correlation matrix mapping every structural plate, forging, and welding consumable directly to EN 10204 Type 3.1 & 3.2 certificates.
Statutory Code Conformance
Strict adherence to ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Codes (Sec II, V, VIII, IX), ASME B31.3 Piping, API 650/620 Tanks, AWS D1.1, and Indian Boiler Regulations (IBR).
Digital Document Verification
Instant online authentication of all issued Inspection Release Notes (IRN) and test endorsements to eliminate counterfeit documentation risks.
We Hear You

At Akshar Engineering Services, we listen closely to your operational challenges, inspection milestone updates, and quality feedback. If you have any problem, report question, or require immediate technical assistance, click below for quick resolution.

service-api-tank-inspection.html:1440.text: Technical Scope & Methodology

Above-ground atmospheric and low-pressure storage tanks storing petroleum crude, chemicals, and cryogenic liquefied gases represent high-consequence industrial assets. Akshar Engineering Services provides comprehensive shop pre-fabrication and on-site field erection surveillance under API 650, API 620, and API 653.

Our certified tank specialists supervise foundation levelness, annular plate vacuum box testing, shell plate verticality, peaking, banding, floating roof seal gap audits, and hydro-test water fill settlement monitoring to guarantee absolute structural integrity and environmental containment.
Key Inspection Stages & Quality Points
Foundation Ring Beam & Pad Settlement Survey
Verifying foundation concrete ring wall levelness, radial tolerances, and asphalt pad slope before bottom plate laying.
Annular & Bottom Plate Vacuum Box Testing
Witnessing bottom lap and annular butt weld vacuum box bubble testing at -5.0 psi (-35 kPa) for complete weld tightness.
Shell Course Erection, Plumbness & Peaking
Auditing vertical weld peaking, horizontal seam banding, shell roundness, and plumbness tolerances per API 650 Sec 7.5.
Floating & Fixed Cone/Dome Roof Erection
Inspecting pontoon compartment air tightness, primary/secondary rim seal gaps, guide poles, and roof drainage systems.
Floor Plate Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL) Scanning
High-resolution MFL scanning of bottom plates during API 653 turnarounds to detect underside soil-side pitting and top-side corrosion.
Hydrostatic Water Fill Test & Settlement Tracking
Monitoring step-wise water filling, shell circumference strain, foundation settlement benchmarks, and roof floating trials.

service-design-examination.html:1440.text: Before metal is cut or welding begins on critical process equipment, rigorous design verification is necessary to guarantee statutory safety and design compliance. Akshar Engineering Services provides independent design appraisal services for pressure vessels, shell-and-tube heat exchangers, storage tanks, and industrial piping.

Our senior design examiners independently review mechanical calculation packages, wind and seismic loadings, nozzle reinforcement calculations, flange ratings, and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) reports against ASME Section VIII, PD 5500, EN 13445, and TEMA standards, issuing formal Design Appraisal Certificates (DAC).
Reviewing process design conditions: design pressure, design temperature, corrosion allowances, and statutory design codes.
Independent re-calculation of required shell thicknesses, ellipsoidal/torispherical head thicknesses, and external vacuum ratings.
Verifying opening reinforcement area replacement per UG-37, WRC 107/297 local stress analysis, and piping loads.
Appraising fixed/floating tubesheet thicknesses, tube-to-tubesheet joint ratings, and baffle spacing calculations.
Structural Support, Saddle & Skirt Stress Analysis
Auditing Zick saddle stress calculations for horizontal vessels and skirt/base ring anchoring for tall vertical columns.
Fabrication GA & Detail Shop Drawing Review
Cross-checking detail shop fabrication drawings, weld joint details, nozzle orientation schedules, and bill of materials.

Auditing purchase order placements for heavy plates, forgings, casting ingots, and monitoring steel mill roll dates.
Physical verification of pattern making, casting pours, forging operations, and rough machining schedules.
Tracking cutting, rolling, fit-up, welding, and internal assembly progress against the master project schedule (L3/L4).

service-ndt-inspection.html:1440.text: Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) is essential to verifying the internal and surface integrity of critical pressure boundary components and structural joints. Akshar Engineering Services delivers independent Level II inspection surveillance and Level III advisory, procedure development, and film interpretation services.

Our specialists ensure that non-destructive testing is performed strictly in accordance with approved written procedures, qualified calibration blocks, and valid code acceptance criteria, detecting subsurface flaws, inclusions, lack of fusion, cracks, and porosity before equipment enters service.
Witnessing manual and semi-automated UT on butt welds, forging forgings, and plates for thickness gauging and flaw sizing.
Independent re-interpretation of X-ray and Gamma-ray industrial radiographic films, verifying density, sensitivity, and defect acceptance.
Fluorescent wet and visible dry powder testing of ferromagnetic welds to detect surface and near-surface linear indications.
Solvent-removable and post-emulsifiable dye penetrant checks on non-magnetic stainless steel, duplex, and nickel alloys.
High-precision optical weld gauge verification for root concavity, excess reinforcement, undercut, and porosity.
ASNT Level III NDT Procedure Audit & Qualification
Drafting, reviewing, and approving written NDT procedures and administering qualification examinations for client technicians.

service-performance-hydro-tests.html:144.text: Pressure and performance proof tests represent the ultimate validation of equipment structural integrity and operating capability. Akshar Engineering Services provides independent engineering surveillance and witnessing for hydrostatic proof tests, pneumatic leak tests, helium mass spectrometer checks, and rotary machinery running tests.

Our surveyors verify dual calibrated pressure gauges, test medium temperature and chloride content, test manifold relief valve protections, pressure holding durations, and zero-leakage criteria across pressure vessels, piping manifolds, valves, and rotating pumps.
Test Circuit & Blind Flange Preparation Audit
Verifying test boundary isolations, temporary blind flange ratings, high-point vent locations, and test manifold safety relief valves.
Verifying valid calibration stickers and master test certificates for dual bourdon pressure gauges and digital chart recorders.
Testing chloride levels (max 30 ppm for austenitic stainless steels) and medium temperature to prevent brittle fracture risks.
Monitoring pressure ramps (50%, 75%, 100%, 150% test pressure), holding duration per code (minimum 30-60 mins), and recording chart traces.
Thorough visual inspection of all longitudinal/circumferential welds, nozzle joints, and gasketed connections during hold.
Witnessing centrifugal pump head vs flow curves, power consumption, bearing vibration spectrum, and NPSH test runs.

service-pre-shipment-inspection.html:144.text: Before any heavy industrial equipment, skid package, valve order, or pressure component departs the manufacturer's workshop, Akshar Engineering Services performs comprehensive Pre-Shipment and Pre-Despatch Inspections (PDI). This crucial final gateway ensures that only defect-free, fully documented, and adequately preserved items are cleared for transport.

Our surveyors verify physical dimensions against approved General Arrangement (GA) drawings, inspect coating dry film thickness (DFT), audit anti-corrosion VCI wrapping, check wooden crating robustness, verify container lashing, and issue formal Inspection Release Notes (IRN) for commercial invoice release.
Checking overall length, nozzle orientations, flange PCD, bolting hole alignment, and nameplate details against GA drawings.
Verifying final dry film thickness (DFT) with calibrated magnetic gauges, holiday spark testing, and RAL color conformance.
Inspecting machined flange rust preventatives, plastic caps, desiccants, and volatile corrosion inhibitor (VCI) shrink wrapping.
Auditing ISPM-15 treated timber crating, saddle supports, internal bracing, lifting lug clearance, and weather-proof lining.
Shipping Markings, Tagging & Center of Gravity
Verifying indelible stencil marks, gross/tare weights, sling lift points, center-of-gravity markers, and barcode tags.
Supervising heavy cargo placement inside containers/flat racks, verifying wire rope tensioning, timber chocking, and container sealing.

service-process-piping.html:1440.text: High-pressure, toxic, and flammable process piping networks demand rigorous quality surveillance during shop pre-fabrication and field tie-in erection. Akshar Engineering Services provides comprehensive piping QA/QC surveillance in strict compliance with ASME B31.3, ASME B31.1, and project engineering specifications.

Our certified piping inspectors verify pipe spool dimensional alignment, flange face serration finishes, gasket specifications, in-process GTAW root pass purging, calibrated bolt torquing, non-destructive testing, and final test pack hydrostatic leak testing.
Checking pipe schedules, seamless/ERW mill test certificates, elbow/tee fittings per ASME B16.9, and flange ratings per ASME B16.5.
Auditing root gap, bevel angles, high-low internal misalignment (<1.5 mm), and argon purge oxygen levels (<50 ppm) for stainless steels.
Monitoring welder identity stamping, WPS parameter adherence, and interpass temperature controls on alloy piping.
Verifying face-to-face dimensions, branch orientation, spool squareness, slope angles, and isometric drawing redlines.

service-process-qualification.html:1440.text: Special manufacturing processes such as thermal heat treatment, blast cleaning, chemical passivation, and protective coating cannot be fully verified by final dimensional checks alone. Akshar Engineering Services provides rigorous process qualification, procedure verification, and continuous shop surveillance for special processes.

Our certified NACE/AMPP coating inspectors and thermal process specialists audit furnace temperature uniformity, thermocouple attachments, Post-Weld Heat Treatment (PWHT) charts, surface cleanliness profiles (Sa 2.5/Sa 3), dry film thickness (DFT), and holiday spark detection.
Verifying furnace calibration surveys per API 6A Annex M, direct thermocouple spot-welding, and insulation wrapping.
Auditing heating rates (°C/hr), holding temperatures, soak times, cooling rates, and maximum inter-thermocouple delta (°C).
Testing ambient dew point, relative humidity, abrasive blast media cleanliness, and surface profile depth (SSPC-SP10 / Sa 2.5).
Conducting Bresle patch tests on blasted steel substrates to ensure soluble chloride levels meet stringent client limits (<20 mg/m²).
Monitoring primer, intermediate, and topcoat application, recoat intervals, and magnetic Dry Film Thickness (DFT) surveys per SSPC-PA2.
Holiday Spark Testing & Adhesion Pull-Off Witness
Conducting high-voltage spark testing for pinhole holidays and witnessing hydraulic pull-off adhesion tests (ASTM D4541).

service-project-shutdown-qa.html:1440.text: Technical Scope & Methodology

Plant maintenance turnarounds and refinery shutdowns operate under intense time pressure where every hour of downtime carries significant financial consequences. Akshar Engineering Services provides elite, rapid-response inspection squads to execute exhaustive asset integrity and quality surveillance during scheduled plant turnarounds.

Our API 510, API 570, and IBR certified inspectors enter process vessels, distillation columns, boilers, furnaces, and piping loops immediately after decontamination to perform internal visual inspections, ultrasonic thickness mapping, corrosion mechanism evaluations, and repair weld sign-offs.
Key Inspection Stages & Quality Points
Column, Drum & Reactor Internal Inspection
Visual and NDT inspection of internal trays, demister pads, weld overlays, refractory linings, and shell wall thinning.
Boiler & Furnace Tube Creep / Thickness Surveys
Ultrasonic thickness surveys, tube sag/bowing measurement, burner tile inspection, and oxide scale evaluation.
Process Piping Loop Corrosion Monitoring
Circuit-by-circuit UT thickness measurement at injection points, elbows, and deadlegs prone to accelerated erosion/corrosion.
Weld Overlay & CRA Clad Repair Surveillance
Witnessing repair excavation, liquid penetrant testing, pre-heat monitoring, and weld buildup of damaged pressure boundaries.
Pressure Relief Valve (PSV) Pop Test Witness
Witnessing bench pop testing, reset pressure verification, seat tightness checks, and calibration tagging of safety valves.
Re-commissioning Hydrotest & Box-Up Clearance
Overseeing system pressure tightness tests, gasket replacement verification, flange bolt torquing, and final box-up clearance.

service-tpi.html:390.text: Akshar Engineering Services Pvt. Ltd. provides fully independent, impartial Third-Party Inspection (TPI) services across all stages of heavy engineering fabrication, pressure equipment manufacturing, and site construction. Our qualified technical surveyors act as the independent third eye on the shop floor, verifying that materials, welding procedures, non-destructive testing, and final assemblies comply strictly with approved engineering drawings, client QAPs, and international codes.

From raw material heat number verification at the steel mill to final hydrostatic testing and Inspection Release Note (IRN) sign-off, our team ensures that no deviation escapes undetected, mitigating project risk and preventing costly field rework.
Verification of mill test certificates (MTC per EN 10204 3.1/3.2), PMI testing, heat mark stamping, and physical defect inspection.
Bevel geometry, root gap, root face measurement, tack weld quality, alignment check, and pre-heat temperature monitoring.
Verification of qualified welders (WPQ), WPS parameter adherence (voltage, amperage, travel speed), and interpass cleaning.
Witnessing Ultrasonic (UT), Radiographic (RT film review), Magnetic Particle (MPI), and Dye Penetrant (DPT) testing.
Witnessing hydrostatic and pneumatic test pressures, verifying calibrated dual gauges, holding time, and zero-leakage sign-off.
GA drawing dimensional check, blast profile, paint DFT audit, packing inspection, and Inspection Release Note (IRN) sign-off.
Submit your scope requirements for fast surveyor mobilization within 24 to 48 hours.

about.html:390.text: Our Company Journey

Akshar Engineering Services Pvt. Ltd. (Formerly known as Akshar Consultancy Services) was established as a dedicated technical assurance and third-party inspection powerhouse. We operate with complete impartiality, independence, and technical rigor across heavy engineering, oil & gas, chemical processing, power generation, renewables, and civil infrastructure.

From our founding, our guiding philosophy has remained unwavering: protect client capital investments and human lives through rigid technical compliance, verified material traceability, and zero-compromise adherence to international codes (ASME, API, AWS, ISO, EN, IBR).
Our Vision

To be the most trusted and recognized global technical inspection and project engineering partner, safeguarding critical industrial assets through uncompromising technical integrity and state-of-the-art engineering practices.
Our Mission

To provide thorough, timely, and fully independent quality assurance, vendor evaluation, and NDT engineering services, ensuring complete compliance with approved ITPs, statutory safety rules, and contractual specifications.
Impartiality Charter

As an ISO/IEC 17020 Type-A body, we guarantee total freedom from commercial, financial, or manufacturing pressures. Our inspectors evaluate purely on technical facts, code criteria, and physical measurement proofs.
Five Pillars of AES Excellence
The core operational disciplines that set Akshar Engineering Services apart in the global technical inspection landscape.
CSWIP & ASNT Certified Inspectors
Our personnel maintain active global qualifications including CSWIP 3.1, AWS CWI, ASNT Level III/II (UT/RT/MPI/DPT), NACE/AMPP Level 2, and API 510/570/653 certifications.
Rapid 24-48h Field Deployment
Strategic surveyor deployment hubs across major industrial corridors in Gujarat, Maharashtra, South India, and overseas networks for rapid on-site mobilization.
Immediate 24-Hour Flash Reports
Daily photographic flash summaries dispatched within 24 hours of inspection completion, giving engineering managers real-time visibility of vendor shop floors.
Complete Material Traceability
Rigid heat number correlation matrix mapping every structural plate, forging, and welding consumable directly to EN 10204 Type 3.1 & 3.2 certificates.
Statutory Code Conformance
Strict adherence to ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Codes (Sec II, V, VIII, IX), ASME B31.3 Piping, API 650/620 Tanks, AWS D1.1, and Indian Boiler Regulations (IBR).
Digital Document Verification
Instant online authentication of all issued Inspection Release Notes (IRN) and test endorsements to eliminate counterfeit documentation risks.
We Hear You

At Akshar Engineering Services, we listen closely to your operational challenges, inspection milestone updates, and quality feedback. If you have any problem, report question, or require immediate technical assistance, click below for quick resolution.
